purpose: Single inventory of page, state and viewport coverage. Route completeness is executable; state completeness still requires product review.

statusPolicy.rules: Rules identify the proposed contract, not a claim that every assertion is enforced. passed/failed requires evidence; the existence of a test is only implemented.
statusPolicy.plannedChecks: Only explicitly mapped axe/visual state checks are implemented. Their execution remains notVerified until immutable reports are attached; all other planned checks are coverage gaps.
statusPolicy.evidence: Use workspace-relative paths from project root. Preserve original and rerun receipts separately; do not count infrastructure errors as rule failures.
